plugins.name: GitHub Copilot
plugins.description: AI pair programmer that suggests code completions, entire functions, and boilerplate inline as you type. Integrates directly into editors via Codex.

plugins.name: Perplexity Search
plugins.description: Real-time web search with cited answers. Routes queries through Perplexity's AI search engine and returns structured citations alongside answers.

plugins.name: Alloy Orchestrator

plugins.name: PluginMesh Broker
plugins.description: This plugin. Routes user goals to the best primary and supporting Codex plugins, generates manifest templates, and coordinates plugin discovery without bypassing authentication.

plugins.name: Linear Issue Tracker

plugins.name: Replit Agent

plugins.name: Vitest Runner

plugins.name: Biome Formatter

plugins.name: Drizzle ORM Assistant

plugins.name: Docker Compose Generator

plugins.name: Storybook Componentizer

plugins.name: Google Calendar

plugins.name: Jira Issue Manager

plugins.name: Google Drive
